# Reader report — SAMPLE bills (generated by `node reader/eval.mjs`, models `nep+hin+eng`)

Scored on 11 fictional bills and 2 cash-book pages in `samples/`. These are **clean synthetic images** with simulated phone-photo wear; real Chauthe bills (handwriting, stamps, creases, Nepali fonts we have not seen) will read worse until the reader is tuned on them. Treat every number below as an upper bound.

Legend: ✓ = reader called it "read" (two readings agree and the bill's own sums fit); ? = reader said "check this"; ✗ after it = the figure was wrong.

| bill | photo | layout | total | subtotal | vat | date_bs | bill_no | pan | vendor | method | head | kind |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| hw01 | clean | invoice | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| nur01 | phone | thermal | ✓ | ✓ | ? | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ? | ✓ | ✓ |
| tea01 | phone | memo | ? | ? | ? | ✓ | ? | ? | ? | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| stat01 | clean | thermal | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ? | ✓ | ✓ |
| fuel01 | phone | thermal | ✓ | ✓ | ? | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ? | ✓ | ✓ |
| jcb01 | clean | invoice | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ? | ✓ | ✓ |
| hall01 | clean | memo | ✓ | ? | ? | ✓ | ? | ? | ? | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| tool01 | clean | thermal | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ? | ✓ | ✓ |
| hw02 | poor | invoice | ?✗ | ?✗ | ?✗ | ✓ | ?✗ | ?✗ | ? | ? | – | ✓ |
| nur02 | poor | thermal | ? | ? | ? | ✓ | ? | ?✗ | ✓ | ? | ✓ | ✓ |
| rec01 | phone | memo | ✓ | ? | ? | ✓ | ? | ? | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |

## Per field

| field | read & right | read but WRONG | check (was right) | check (was wrong) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| total | 8 | **0** | 2 | 1 |
| subtotal | 6 | **0** | 4 | 1 |
| vat | 4 | **0** | 6 | 1 |
| date_bs | 11 | **0** | 0 | 0 |
| bill_no | 6 | **0** | 4 | 1 |
| pan | 6 | **0** | 3 | 2 |
| vendor | 8 | **0** | 3 | 0 |
| method | 4 | **0** | 7 | 0 |

"read but WRONG" is the number to drive to zero: a figure the app shows as read although it is not right. The person still confirms every entry, but they should never be lulled by a tick.

## Cash-book pages

| page | rows | rows found | read & right | read but WRONG | check |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| cb01 | 8 | 8 | 2 | **0** | 6 |
| cb02 | 6 | 6 | 4 | **0** | 2 |

**Read but wrong, all fields: 0.** Read and right: 59.
